description.html: This dish is shaped like a cross-section of a tree stump, but in an unusual bright yellow. The bottom has stylized growth rings as raised lines, and the outer rim is brown bark. The shape is kidney-like and shallow, with a wide bottom.

Unlike dishes that blend into their surroundings, the yellow stump is meant to be seen. It adds a cheerful splash of color to a terrarium with green plants or a dark substrate, and kids who follow their pet love it too. The strong color is practical as well: you can see the water level and any dirt in it at a glance.
Thanks to its shallow, wide shape, the dish works as a water bowl for smaller lizards and geckos, as well as a feeder for insects and vegetables.

The raised rings on the bottom trap sediment, so clean them with a small brush once a week. Change the water every day and remove food leftovers the same day. Place the dish on a level surface on the cooler side of the terrarium so the water does not evaporate too quickly.
